title: 贝恩资本John：AI估值高企，回报能否兑现？
speaker: John Connaughton

segments.en: There's fears in this market of a bubble. I mean, where are you on that debate?
segments.zh: 市场担心有泡沫。你怎么看？

segments.en: Right now, John. There's definitely bubbles that will pop.
segments.zh: 约翰，现在肯定有泡沫会破。

segments.en: But I think for me, I lived through the.com bubble.
segments.zh: 但我经历过互联网泡沫。

segments.en: We bought a company. It was an online trading business right as the Nasdaq one from 5,200 down to 3,600.
segments.zh: 我们买了一家在线交易公司，当时纳斯达克从5200跌到3600。

segments.en: But it was a great company and it was growing and we merged it with two other companies.
segments.zh: 但它是好公司，在增长，我们把它和另外两家合并了。

segments.en: And the fundamentals during that type of bubble bursting, still powered that company through that cycle.
segments.zh: 在那种估值重估中，基本面仍推动公司度过周期。

segments.en: So from our standpoint, we look at the valuations to be very high.
segments.zh: 所以从我们角度看，估值非常高。

segments.en: But the real question on AI is, are you going to get a return on that valuation?
segments.zh: 但AI的真正问题是，你能从估值中获得回报吗？

segments.en: And a lot of people talk about demand as the KPI.
segments.zh: 很多人把需求当作关键指标。

segments.en: Are people doing their searches on Anthropic and Claude? Are they doing re-engineering with their R&D?
segments.zh: 人们在Anthropic和Claude上搜索吗？在研发中重构吗？

segments.en: I think at so early stage, I don't think people really understand yet how much of the ROI is going to be there to justify the $10 trillion of investment.
segments.zh: 在这么早期阶段，我认为人们还没真正理解能有多少回报来证明这10万亿美元投入的合理性。

segments.en: And so that's where we come in. You know, we're all about trying to go into companies, not just to defuse the technology, but actually make it work by changing the enterprise
segments.zh: 这就是我们的切入点。我们致力于进入公司，不仅是为了推广技术，更是通过改变企业来让它真正发挥作用，

segments.en: and creating the value that allows them to adopt it fundamentally.
segments.zh: 并创造价值，使他们能够从根本上采用它。

segments.en: And that's why private equity is such a great solution for enterprise change.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么私募股权是企业变革的绝佳解决方案。

segments.en: You know, we control the companies. We come in top down.
segments.zh: 我们控制公司，自上而下地介入。

segments.en: You know, we have a huge team of portfolio value creation on our staff.
segments.zh: 我们拥有庞大的**组合价值创造团队。

segments.en: We're building our engineering talent on top of that. And so I think it's a big opportunity for private equity.
segments.zh: 在此基础上，我们正在建设工程人才队伍。因此，我认为这对私募股权来说是一个重大机遇。

segments.en: I think it's a terrific opportunity for us.
segments.zh: 我认为这对我们来说是一个绝佳的机会。
